newsitem.title: USA: Nexstar drug AmBisome okayed by FDA panel.
newsitem.headline: Nexstar drug AmBisome okayed by FDA panel.

text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc and Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Ltd Co's Fujisawa USA Inc unit said Wednesday a U.S. Food and Drug Administration panel has declared the drug AmBisome to be safe and effective for treatment of fungal infections.
The FDA advisory panel found the drug safe and effective as empirical therapy for presumed fungal infections in febrile neutropenic (low white blood cell count) adult and pediatric patients.
The committee's decision is not binding on the FDA, but the companies said it represents a significant step forward in their joint effort to win FDA approval for the product.
Empirical therapy is treatment based upon the clinical symptoms of a patient, rather than the results of culture tests, they said.
